page.overview:
Who is Wilson Fittipaldi Júnior?

Wilson Fittipaldi (born in São Paulo, Brazil – died in São Paulo, Brazil).

He participated in 38 (35) Formula One Grands Prix in the 1970s driving initially for (-) and then for (), which existed from ( to ). Wilsinho achieved his best result during the 1974 German Grand Prix contested on the formidable Nordschleife of the Nürburgring (5th).

He participated of four non-Championship Formula One races and your best result was a 3rd place finish at 1972 Brazilian Grand Prix, where he drove a Brabham to the podium.

Wilsinho Fittipaldi died in São Paulo, Brazil, on 23 February 2024.
